layout.<agent>/instructions.md: baseline system prompt (the optimizer's baseline) — never edited to 'fix' it; the flaws are the point
layout.<agent>/tools.json: function-calling (and, for 04/07, declared MCP) tool definitions — omitted where the agent has none
layout.<agent>/dataset/optimize.jsonl: 20 rows — the ONLY file uploadable to the wizard/CLI for the optimization run (enforced by _tools/build_foundry_dataset.py)
layout.<agent>/dataset/holdout.jsonl: 10 rows — never uploaded; used exclusively by the post-optimization scoring step, so reported deltas are not fit-to-what-the-optimizer-saw
layout.<agent>/expected/expectations.json: the expectations contract: must_have / nice_to_have / should_edit / should_remove / should_add / must_not_appear, tool rules, rubrics, agent tests (tagged optimize/holdout), scoring bands, dataset_split, judge_config, known traps
layout.<agent>/README.md: what this sample is designed to expose, and which review findings it was built or extended to address
layout._schema/expectations.schema.json: JSON Schema (v2.0.0) for the expectations contract, including dataset_split and judge_config
layout._tools/validate_candidate.py: scores an optimized candidate against its contract; refuses to run against a holdout-informed candidate; exits 1 on a critical failure; semantic rules go to an UNJUDGED queue, never silently pass
layout._tools/build_foundry_dataset.py: strips authoring fields to produce a portal-ready upload from optimize.jsonl ONLY — hard-refuses holdout.jsonl by filename
layout._tools/similarity_baseline.py: n-gram cosine similarity with a permutation null AND a cross-agent null baseline, plus an expectations-agreement (Jaccard) axis so lexical and substantive similarity are never conflated
layout._tools/run_manifest_template.json: per-run reproducibility record — model versions, timestamps, wizard config, inference temperature — copy one per optimizer run
